title: Translating Points

pages.prompt: Move the point 4 steps to the right and 1 up.
pages.explain: The point starts at (1, 2). After moving it 4 steps right and 1 step up, it will be at (5, 3).

pages.prompt: Move the point 4 steps to the right and 1 up.
pages.explain: The point starts at (2, 4). After moving it 4 steps right and 1 step up, it will be at (6, 5).

pages.prompt: Moving points is described as a translation. A translation by *(a, b)* moves every point on the plane *a* steps right and *b* steps up.
Translate the points to the targets.
pages.explain: A translation by (2, 1) will move the points to the targets.

pages.prompt: Translate the points to the targets.
pages.explain: A translation by (3, 2) will move the points 3 steps right and 2 steps up, landing on the targets.

pages.prompt: Translate the points to the targets.
pages.explain: A translation by (2, 3) will move the points 2 steps right and 3 steps up, landing on the targets.

pages.prompt: A translation moves any number of points in the same way.

pages.explain: Each point needs to move 1 step right and 3 steps up, so the translation is (1, 3).
Each point needs to move 4 steps right and 0 steps up, so the translation is (4, 0).
Each point needs to move 5 steps right and 2 steps up, so the translation is (5, 2).

coach.P1: Ok so, let's go. Count the steps, then move it.
coach.P2: Same move, new starting spot. You've got this.
coach.P3: Ok, here's the idea behind it.
coach.P4: Now you pick the numbers. No stress.
coach.P5: Three of them now. One move works for all.
coach.P6: Four this time. Same idea, you've got it.
